decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends Söbbeke's established organic and biodynamic dairy range, so it builds directly on the firm's core knowledge in production, sourcing and marketing, and the firm can easily interpret its sales results and refine it.

Mild sliced cheese sits close to the firm's existing organic cheese know-how and was given its own product page in 2024, which signals commitment and enough related capacity to adjust it in response to early market feedback.

Sliced butter cheese is a closely related variant of the firm's established cheese portfolio, sharing processes and sales channels, so it is cheap to keep while the firm learns from its first full year on the market.
